// diagnostic

E0231

A method's stated receiver footprint (`&self.log`, `&self.[log, hits]`) names no field of its record, or its body reads or changes a field outside it.

What

A method's stated receiver footprint (`&self.log`, `&self.[log, hits]`) names no field of its record, or its body reads or changes a field outside it.

Why

Callers and the published API see the stated footprint, so it must name stored fields and the body must stay inside it.

Fix

Add the field to the receiver's footprint, or change the method to stay inside it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0231: tests/ui/method_footprint_outside.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidReceiverFootprint]: `log_hit` uses `self.hits` outside its stated footprint `self.log`
  --> tests/ui/method_footprint_outside.jet:9:14
    |
  9 |         self.hits += 1
    |              ^^^^
 Why: Callers and the published API see the stated footprint, so the body must stay inside it
 Fix: Add the field to the receiver's footprint, or change `log_hit` to stay inside `self.log`
